CREATE TABLE "runtime_host_capacity_intents" (
    intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(intent_id)='text' AND length(trim(intent_id))>0 AND instr(intent_id,char(0))=0),
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) CHECK(typeof(workspace_id)='text' AND length(trim(workspace_id))>0 AND instr(workspace_id,char(0))=0),
    workspace_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(workspace_key)='text' AND length(trim(workspace_key))>0 AND instr(workspace_key,char(0))=0),
    canonical_cwd TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(canonical_cwd)='text' AND length(trim(canonical_cwd))>0 AND instr(canonical_cwd,char(0))=0),
    database_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(database_path)='text' AND length(trim(database_path))>0 AND instr(database_path,char(0))=0),
    database_file_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(database_file_identity)='text' AND length(trim(database_file_identity))>0 AND instr(database_file_identity,char(0))=0),
    owner_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_kind IN ('attempt','workflow_start','delegation_spawn','approval_resume_pending','user_input_continuation')),
    owner_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(owner_key)='text' AND length(trim(owner_key))>0 AND instr(owner_key,char(0))=0),
    authority_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(authority_digest)='text' AND length(trim(authority_digest))>0 AND instr(authority_digest,char(0))=0 AND length(authority_digest)=64 AND length(CAST(authority_digest AS BLOB))=64 AND authority_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    run_id TEXT REFERENCES run_sessions(id) CHECK(run_id IS NULL OR (typeof(run_id)='text' AND length(trim(run_id))>0 AND instr(run_id,char(0))=0)),
    work_unit_id TEXT REFERENCES work_units(id) CHECK(work_unit_id IS NULL OR (typeof(work_unit_id)='text' AND length(trim(work_unit_id))>0 AND instr(work_unit_id,char(0))=0)),
    attempt_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES work_unit_attempts(id) CHECK(attempt_id IS NULL OR (typeof(attempt_id)='text' AND length(trim(attempt_id))>0 AND instr(attempt_id,char(0))=0)),
    runtime_instance_id TEXT CHECK(runtime_instance_id IS NULL OR (typeof(runtime_instance_id)='text' AND length(trim(runtime_instance_id))>0 AND instr(runtime_instance_id,char(0))=0)),
    fencing_token TEXT CHECK(fencing_token IS NULL OR (typeof(fencing_token)='text' AND length(trim(fencing_token))>0 AND instr(fencing_token,char(0))=0)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='text' AND length(trim(created_at))>0 AND instr(created_at,char(0))=0 AND length(created_at)=24
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at,'+0 days')=created_at),
    reservation_id TEXT UNIQUE CHECK(reservation_id IS NULL OR (typeof(reservation_id)='text' AND length(trim(reservation_id))>0 AND instr(reservation_id,char(0))=0)),
    reservation_token TEXT CHECK(reservation_token IS NULL OR (typeof(reservation_token)='text' AND length(trim(reservation_token))>0 AND instr(reservation_token,char(0))=0 AND length(reservation_token)=64 AND length(CAST(reservation_token AS BLOB))=64 AND reservation_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
    host_policy_revision INTEGER CHECK(host_policy_revision IS NULL OR
      (typeof(host_policy_revision)='integer' AND host_policy_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991)),
    reserved_at TEXT CHECK(reserved_at IS NULL OR (typeof(reserved_at)='text' AND length(trim(reserved_at))>0 AND instr(reserved_at,char(0))=0 AND length(reserved_at)=24
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',reserved_at,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',reserved_at,'+0 days')=reserved_at)),
    dispatch_token TEXT UNIQUE CHECK(dispatch_token IS NULL OR (typeof(dispatch_token)='text' AND length(trim(dispatch_token))>0 AND instr(dispatch_token,char(0))=0 AND length(dispatch_token)=64 AND length(CAST(dispatch_token AS BLOB))=64 AND dispatch_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
    dispatched_at TEXT CHECK(dispatched_at IS NULL OR (typeof(dispatched_at)='text' AND length(trim(dispatched_at))>0 AND instr(dispatched_at,char(0))=0 AND length(dispatched_at)=24
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',dispatched_at,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',dispatched_at,'+0 days')=dispatched_at)),
    revoked_at TEXT CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR (typeof(revoked_at)='text' AND length(trim(revoked_at))>0 AND instr(revoked_at,char(0))=0 AND length(revoked_at)=24
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',revoked_at,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',revoked_at,'+0 days')=revoked_at)),
    UNIQUE(workspace_id,owner_kind,owner_key),
    CHECK((run_id IS NULL AND work_unit_id IS NULL AND attempt_id IS NULL AND runtime_instance_id IS NULL AND fencing_token IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND work_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND runtime_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND fencing_token IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(owner_kind<>'attempt' OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND work_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND runtime_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND fencing_token IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK((reservation_id IS NULL AND reservation_token IS NULL AND host_policy_revision IS NULL AND reserved_at IS NULL AND dispatch_token IS NULL) OR (reservation_id IS NOT NULL AND reservation_token IS NOT NULL AND host_policy_revision IS NOT NULL AND reserved_at IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_token IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(dispatched_at IS NULL OR (reservation_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR (reservation_id IS NOT NULL AND dispatched_at IS NULL))
  )
